Your Mac and iPhone have a built-in document scanner! 🥰 Here’s how to do it in 10 seconds:  1️⃣ Right-click anywhere on your Mac desktop, in a Finder folder, or inside an Apple Note. 2️⃣ Hover over “Import from iPhone (or iPad)” and click Scan Documents. 3️⃣ Your iPhone camera will automatically open! Just point it at your paper, syllabus, or textbook page. As soon as you snap it, the scanned PDF pops up directly on your Mac in real time! 📄🚀 (Just make sure Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are enabled on both devices with the same Apple ID) hidden mac trick | scan documents to mac with iphone | continuity camera mac tutorial | macbook tips for students | apple ecosystem hacks | mac scanner shortcut #macbook #macbooktips #macbookhacks #tipsandtricks #techblogger
